scope.description: An optional lighting direction for user-requested outdoor group scenes beneath a leafy canopy in daylight. Place broken light-color touches selectively on clothing planes and the ground, keeping faces and the group's visual relationships readable. This narrows the base package's general outdoor light into a controlled placement rule; it does not prescribe a swing, dance, picnic, or fixed cast.
limitations: Activate only for a user-requested group beneath a leafy canopy in daylight.
Preserve the user's people, count, identity, pose, clothing, activity, and spatial relationships.
Keep facial recognition areas and important expressions legible; do not paint bright flecks over eyes or distinctive features.
Concentrate light touches on selected clothing planes and ground; do not cover every surface evenly.
Do not add a swing, dance, picnic, crowd, or named scene unless requested.
Do not reproduce the composition or figure arrangement of La Balançoire or another named work.

rules.applies_when: The user requests people outdoors beneath a leafy canopy in daylight.
rules.instruction: Render filtered canopy light as irregular light-color touches on selected clothing planes and ground patches; keep most large surfaces in their local colors.
rules.observable: Bright broken notes appear in both clothing and ground while the scene retains coherent daylight and local color.
rules.reject_when: Light becomes a uniform overlay, every surface is speckled, or bright marks obscure essential clothing structure.
rules.avoid: all-over glitter, hard spotlight circles, or global color wash

rules.applies_when: One or more faces are visible in the requested group scene.
rules.instruction: Keep eyes, nose, mouth, and expression areas comparatively free of the brightest flecks; carry dappled highlights around faces onto hair, hats, shoulders, and nearby fabric instead.
rules.observable: Faces remain identifiable and expressions readable against the broken light pattern.
rules.reject_when: A bright spot erases an eye, merges facial features, or makes expressions unreadable.
rules.avoid: face-obscuring foliage patterns, glittery skin, uniformly lit masks

rules.applies_when: The user requests multiple people within one shared outdoor setting.
rules.instruction: Repeat a few related light-color notes between nearby clothing and ground patches so figures feel present in the same filtered daylight, while preserving distinct silhouettes and interactions.
rules.observable: The light pattern connects figures to the ground without merging people or inventing new interactions.
rules.reject_when: Repetition creates false limbs, merges separate people, or changes the requested group arrangement.
rules.avoid: mirrored poses, extra figures, repeated copy-pasted silhouettes

joint_checks.instruction: Keep the requested group readable under leafy daylight, place sparse broken highlights on selected clothing and ground, and protect faces and figure boundaries.
joint_checks.observable: Dappled light is visibly localized, expressions remain readable, and each requested person stays distinct.
